kinds.d: Interactive program that teaches a language by testing, correcting or adapting to the user's answers.
Program that translates text between languages automatically.
Program that turns the user's speech into typed text and voice commands.
Program that turns written text into spoken audio with synthetic voices.
Program that turns keystrokes into the characters of a language such as Japanese or Chinese, using conversion dictionaries.
Program that teaches touch typing with drills that test and correct the user's keystrokes.
Program that helps a human translator with translation memories, term bases and segment-by-segment editing.

notes: Restraint-only. Language-learning 27->12 (dropped tutoring marketplace Preply and minor apps). Machine translation 12->10: cloud APIs Amazon Translate and IBM Watson Language Translator dropped per brief. Dictation 48->12: AmiVoice SDK/business/medical SKUs, Dragon Legal/Medical/Law Enforcement editions (now types), Philips SpeechExec/SpeechLive dictation-workflow products, IBM ViaVoice and MacSpeech Scribe (discontinued) and the long tail of small Whisper front-ends dropped. Text-to-speech 13->8: cloud API Amazon Polly, AT&T Natural Voices, LumenVox (enterprise), FreeTTS and Apple PlainTalk dropped; the old list has few current consumer read-aloud apps, a later web pass could add them. Input method editor 17->11 (dropped Google Pinyin, Microsoft Korean IME, Matsutake, VJE, Wnn). Typing tutor kept all 7. CAT tool kept all 5. No new kinds.
